faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about our services
faq.q1: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faq.a1: Our MOQ varies by product type, starting from 1,000 pieces for standard items and 3,000 pieces for custom OEM orders.
faq.q2: How long is your lead time?
faq.a2: Standard orders take 2-3 weeks, while custom OEM orders typically require 4-6 weeks depending on complexity.
faq.a3: Yes, we provide samples for quality evaluation. Sample fees are refundable upon placing a bulk order.
faq.a4: We are HACCP, ISO22000, BRC Grade A, and Halal certified. Our products meet international food safety standards.
